scripts.test:e2e: bun run test:e2e:open && bun run test:e2e:run ; bun run test:e2e:close
scripts.test:e2e:open: bun run test:e2e:up && DB_PORT=5435 bun run src/tests/e2e/scripts/apply-schema.ts
scripts.test:e2e:run: DB_PORT=5435 KAFKA_BROKERS=localhost:9094 REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380 bun test src/tests/e2e --concurrency 1
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: sh -c 'bun run test:e2e:open; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then bun run test:e2e:coverage:run; status=$?; fi; bun run test:e2e:close; exit $status'
scripts.test:e2e:coverage:run: DB_PORT=5435 KAFKA_BROKERS=localhost:9094 REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380 bun test src/tests/e2e --coverage --coverage-reporter=text --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=coverage/e2e --concurrency 1
scripts.test:e2e:mutation:project-members: sh -c 'bun run test:e2e:open; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then bun run test:e2e:mutation:project-members:run; status=$?; fi; bun run test:e2e:close; exit $status'
scripts.test:e2e:mutation:project-members:dry: sh -c 'bun run test:e2e:open; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then bun run test:e2e:mutation:project-members:dry:run; status=$?; fi; bun run test:e2e:close; exit $status'
scripts.test:e2e:mutation:task-flow: sh -c 'bun run test:e2e:open; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then bun run test:e2e:mutation:task-flow:run; status=$?; fi; bun run test:e2e:close; exit $status'
scripts.test:e2e:mutation:task-flow:dry: sh -c 'bun run test:e2e:open; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then bun run test:e2e:mutation:task-flow:dry:run; status=$?; fi; bun run test:e2e:close; exit $status'
scripts.test:e2e:mutation: sh -c 'bun run test:e2e:open; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then bun run test:e2e:mutation:all:run; status=$?; fi; bun run test:e2e:close; exit $status'
scripts.test:e2e:mutation:dry: sh -c 'bun run test:e2e:open; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then bun run test:e2e:mutation:all:dry:run; status=$?; fi; bun run test:e2e:close; exit $status'
scripts.test:e2e:mutation:all:run: bun run test:e2e:mutation:project-members:run && bun run test:e2e:mutation:task-flow:run
